tasks.label: backend: serve
tasks.command: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalAddress 127.0.0.1 -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'Laravel is already running on 127.0.0.1:8000.' } else { & 'C:\php-8.5.7\php.exe' artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000 }

background.endsPattern: Press Ctrl\+C to stop|Laravel is already running on 127\.0\.0\.1:8000\.

tasks.label: vite: dev
tasks.command: if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalAddress 127.0.0.1 -LocalPort 5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'Vite is already running on 127.0.0.1:5173.' } else { npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort }
